correctness.rationale: Real cyclic signals n>=3 and all strictly positive weights are quantified. Each strict max chamber is a neighbor selector and every binary sign assignment except all equal is realized by nonzero cyclic increments. Layer-cake decomposition plus connected-arc splitting reduces each selector BV norm to one arc. Only the two arc boundary entries can change; all four choices are realized by strict cyclic base vectors and small step perturbations. The 1-site and 2-wall case analysis proves the explicit L1/L2 formula, and the parity argument proves rigidity and alternating sharpness. Exact rational checker independently enumerates all strict selectors and binary steps for n=3..8, checks 3,984 actual two-input witnesses, and checks claimed corollaries. Finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The full classification quantifies exact perturbation sensitivity of a standard periodic morphological primitive under arbitrary positive, nonuniform first-variation costs. Unlike one-input TVD and path-window formulas, cyclic geometry couples two separated boundary walls. Even the 4-cycle (1,2,1,2) has a sharp 2-wall gain 2 while every singleton or co-singleton cut is bounded by 4/3; hence the nonlocal mechanism is indispensable. The uniform-only nonexpansivity theorem and exact alternating family give complete interpretable design constraints for all cycle sizes, without an arbitrary numerical parameter slice.
